name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User confirmed the Test19 emergency rollback restored File Management. Test20 reintroduces only recent-play capture through a small exported helper module and a pre-save syntax gate.

features: restore the Test17 File Management V9 source from its immutable validated commit before adding playback-history hooks
add a compact ▶ 最近 entry to File Management
record up to 50 recent videos only when a video is explicitly played from File Management
route playback tracking through a small exported 115PlayStore module instead of embedding a large nested longClick source fragment
add a V2 recent-play page with 最近 / 收藏 tabs, replay, open-source-folder, remove and clear actions
allow videos already present in recent history to be added to or removed from local favorites
all recent/favorite data remains local UI state and adds no background or list-time 115 requests

safety.syntaxGuard: Node syntax checks were run on play_store_v1.js, play_history_v2.js and installer.js before publication; installer also calls new Function() on the final File Management source, store and history modules before saving the rule.

limitations: This retry intentionally does not add a File Management long-press video-favorite hook; favorites are toggled from the recent-play page after a video has been played.
Search and OfflineResult playback are not patched in this slice so their established stable chains remain untouched.
validationTarget: File Management opens without a JavaScript compile error
existing Test17 folder favorites/recent folders, sort/filter and file operations remain normal
playing one video from File Management still starts playback and creates a recent record
最近 page can replay that video and open its original directory
long-pressing an item in 最近 can add/remove it from 收藏
clearing recent or favorites only clears local history data
